title: Introduce manifest lifecycle annotations and automated impact extractor
author: Priya Kapoor
description:
Motivation: onboarding workflows today attach free-form manifest fields which makes automated release-note and impact extraction brittle. This change introduces a small, versioned annotation layer for model manifests plus an automated impact extractor service that synthesizes concise release hints and a delta map for performance-profile changes.
Goals: 1) provide a stable, typed place for lifecycle metadata (deprecation, compatibility matrix, recommended rollback window); 2) produce machine-readable impact summaries for use in the on-boarding pipeline and autodraft release notes; 3) detect and highlight performance profile deltas (latency/cost/quality) and attach human-readable one-line hints for release authors.
Summary of changes:
 - schema: add manifest lifecycle annotations (registry/schemas/lifecycle_annotations_v1.yaml) and bump manifest schema version to v1.3.
 - extractor: new small service and CLI (registry/tools/impact_extractor.py, registry/tools/cli.py) that consumes two manifest versions and outputs a delta summary (JSON/markdown) and an autodraft blurb.
 - changelog hook: add pipeline hook that runs extractor during model-onboard CI and appends suggested release notes to the PR body (ci/hooks/impact-hook.sh).
 - tests: unit tests and integration smoke tests for typical model-onboard delta patterns (tests/extractor/test_delta_mapping.py).
 - docs: onboarding guide and migration notes (docs/onboard/annotations.md).
Rollout plan: feature gated by registry.feature_flags.extractor (off by default). We'll run the extractor in CI for a couple of weeks to collect suggestions, then flip the feature flag once maintainers confirm quality.
Backwards compatibility: manifests without lifecycle annotations are accepted; extractor treats missing fields as unknown and generates conservative hints.
Checklist:
 - [x] Add schema and implementation
 - [x] Unit + integration tests
 - [x] CI hook wiring
 - [x] Docs and migration guide
 - [x] Add feature flag and telemetry counters
Related: ENG-1842 (annotation schema), ENG-1899 (autodraft release automation), SUP-1421 (customer support request to make release notes more actionable).
Test plan: unit tests, sample onboards in staging that exercise combinations of performance-profile changes (improve/worsen/unchanged), manual review of 10 recent model-onboards with suggested blurbs, smoke run in CI that writes suggestions to a staging S3 bucket.
Migration notes: custodians should opt into adding lifecycle annotations over time; missing annotation fields are optional.
Security: extractor runs on internal CI with no external network egress, manifests are sanitized before analysis.
